summary: On 19 January 2026 attackers breached two servers of Senegal's Directorate of File Automation (DAF), the office that manages national ID cards, passports and biometric data, and stole card personalization data from one of them, according to an email from IRIS Corporation Berhad, the Malaysian contractor building Senegal's new digital ID cards. A ransomware gang calling itself Green Blood Group claimed the theft of 139 GB including citizen database records, biometric data and immigration documents and published samples; the government temporarily suspended the office's operations and confirmed the breach.
